name: l2norm
description: L2 normalization over the last dimension: out=(x.float()*rsqrt(sum(x.float()**2,dim=-1,keepdim=True)+eps)).to(x.dtype). x may have any leading dimensions but the final dimension must be positive; eps defaults to 1e-6. Returns a new tensor with x's shape. Current tests exercise bfloat16 2-D inputs with widths 64..1024; no mutation.
